source_request: 좀 더 역동적인 모습으로 국군 홍보 포스터 느낌으로 프롬프트 설계하고 그려줘.
interpreted_intent: Keep the prior reference adult and special-warfare identity while replacing the calm training pause with a visibly dynamic forward action and a polished Republic of Korea Armed Forces promotional-poster treatment.
subject: The same adult woman from the attached portrait, with the previously preserved facial structure and long dark wavy hair, presented as a modern Republic of Korea special-warfare operator.
setting: A rain-wet military obstacle course at sunrise, composed as poster-ready national-defense campaign key art.
event: She drives forward through the obstacle course as one boot strikes a shallow puddle, throwing a sharp arc of water while her gear moves with the stride.
visual_priorities: clear full-body forward motion readable at poster scale
recognizable facial and adult-age continuity with the attached portrait
heroic Republic of Korea Armed Forces campaign hierarchy
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces promotional poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the reference portrait as a modern special-warfare operator. Preserve her eye aperture and spacing, long oval face, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, adult age, and long dark wavy hair. She powers forward through a rain-wet obstacle course, one boot striking a shallow puddle into a sharp arc of spray as her torso leans into the stride. Her matte helmet, communications headset, olive-and-charcoal combat uniform, plate carrier, and pouches move with believable weight; a compact carbine stays controlled across her chest on its sling, muzzle angled down. Frame her full body from a low three-quarter angle with strong diagonal perspective, while the upper sky remains a clean field reserved for later campaign typography. A rising sun breaks through cool storm haze behind her, producing crisp rim light, airborne droplets, and a restrained red-blue tonal counterpoint. Her focused gaze reaches beyond the camera toward the objective. The result reads as premium national-defense recruitment campaign key art: energetic, disciplined, capable, and resolutely forward-moving.
